reviews.outcome: No new serious defect confirmed in the selected multidimensional setup. A.1 explicitly leaves variable-to-block bookkeeping unstated; the corpus supplies native free/protected-block handling and function graph recursion. The source permits equality translations, but the internal-model carrier paragraph is not used as a proof of quotient-carrier truth: the quotient/congruence argument is developed locally using the existing equality-axiom treatment. No advanced bi-interpretability/synonymy theorem is adopted.
